title: Algorithmic Market Making Can Lead to Rough Volatility Through the Order Book
abstract: arXiv:2611.24028v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing work suggests that markets can show volatility with paths rougher than those of Brownian motion. In theory this can happen when the order flow is close to instability with memory that decays as a power law. However, it is not fully clear how such order flow could arise from the predominantly algorithmic market making that characterizes order book dynamics. We show one such consistent mechanism. We treat each market maker as a desk that uses a first-order gradient rule to move the distances of its orders from the mid price toward target distances provided by an unknown oracle. We assume that distinct desks do not act synchronously in time but act whenever new information relevant to their respective oracles arrives, which each desk samples over its own characteristic lookback horizon. translated_title: 算法化做市可通过订单簿导致粗糙波动率
translated_abstract: 现有研究表明，市场可能表现出比布朗运动路径更粗糙的波动率。理论上，当订单流接近不稳定状态且其记忆按幂律衰减时，这种情况就可能发生。然而，这种订单流如何从以算法化做市为主导的订单簿动态中产生，目前尚不完全清楚。我们展示了这样一种自洽的机制。我们将每个做市商视为一个交易台，该交易台使用一阶梯度规则将其订单与中间价的距离朝某个未知“神谕”所提供的目标距离进行调整。我们假设不同的交易台在时间上并不同步行动，而是在与其各自神谕相关的新信息到达时才采取行动，每个交易台都在其自身特有的回溯时间范围内对这些信息进行采样。因此，在所有交易台之间，该规则表现为带有信息驱动（小批量）噪声的随机梯度下降（SGD）。在连续（极限下……）
tldr: 本文提出一种自洽机制，将做市商建模为采用随机梯度下降规则、异步响应新信息调整报价的交易台，从而证明算法化做市可以通过订单簿动态自然地产生粗糙波动率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-consistent mechanism modeling market makers as desks that use stochastic gradient descent to asynchronously adjust quotes in response to new information, showing that algorithmic market making can naturally generate rough volatility through order book dynamics.
